class: I-Aleph (Pe-Aleph, quiescent: אבד, אבה, אכל, אמר, אפה) — Qal differing squares only
rootNote: Teaching root אָכַל (tutor ruling 2026-11-21 4:09 PM ET). It is the root GKC Paradigm I, Davidson §35 and K&J print, it is regular (wayyiqtol וַיֹּאכַל with pataḥ, pausal ṣere יֹאכֵל), and it attests the same 12 of 14 squares as אמר. אָמַר keeps its attested forms where they matter: וַיֹּאמֶר is the wayyiqtol alternate (attested example from אמר) and לֵאמֹר is a note on the infinitive construct square.
source: GKC §68 and Paradigm I (PDF pp. 480-481); Davidson §35 p. 171; OSHB/WLC; STEPBible TAHOT
verificationMethod: Each form was matched (consonants + vowel points, accents ignored, dagesh lene and plene/defective ḥolem, shureq and ḥireq-yod spellings normalized) against OSHB morphhb-wlc tokens with the same OSHB morph slot. R1 is the literal quiescent א; R2/R3 positional; a begadkefat radical's dagesh in dagesh-lene position is optional; Hitpael is matched both with and without sibilant metathesis (הִשְׁתַּ- / הִתְ-). The example's root (with shin/sin dot) was checked against the Strong's headword for its lemma number. Example roots: only אבד (H6), אכל (H398), אמר (H559); אבה and אפה are also III-He and never examples. Ketiv excluded. Infinitives construct may carry a preposition (examplePrefix). Example preference: teaching root, then אמר/אבד; each in order no prefix, ו, preposition. Every matched token was cross-checked against STEPBible TAHOT; tokens where TAHOT disagrees are never used as examples.

notes.scope: This file holds only the Qal squares where the five quiescent I-Aleph verbs differ from weak-iguttural.json. All other squares: see 'sameAsIGuttural'.
notes.fiveVerbs: GKC §68.1: אָבַד, אָבָה, אָכַל, אָמַר, אָפָה. אבה and אפה are also III-He, so they are never used as examples here. Other I-Aleph verbs (אסף, אחז, אהב) quiesce only sometimes (יֹאסֵף/יֶאֱסֹף, יֹאחֵז/יֶאֱחֹז) and are not examples.
notes.cohortative: Cohortative 1cs אֹכְלָה (Davidson p. 171), אֹמְרָה. Note only.

sameAsIGuttural.note: אָכַל, אָכְלָה, אֲכַלְתֶּם … = עָמַד pattern (GKC Paradigm I: 'Like verbs primae gutturalis').

Derived stems are like verbs primae gutturalis (GKC Paradigm I; §68 Rem. 1), with ḥaṭeph seghol under א (נֶאֱכַל, הֶאֱכִיל, יַאֲכִיל). Only isolated quiescent forms occur (GKC §68 Rem. 1). Piel/Pual/Hitpael are regular.
